description: This file implements configuration and transformation logic for the Fal AI Recraft v3 text-to-image model. It defines a class FalAIRecraftV3Config that handles parameter mapping, request transformation, and response processing for the image generation API.

classes.name: FalAIRecraftV3Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Recraft v3 text-to-image model, supporting parameter mapping, request/response transformation, and model-specific options.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by Recraft v3.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Recraft v3-specific parameters, transforming or ignoring unsupported ones based on flags.

methods.name: Any _map_image_size(self, size: str)
methods.description: Converts OpenAI size specifiers into Recraft v3 size presets or custom width/height dicts.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Creates a Recraft v3-specific request body from given prompt and parameters.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms raw Recraft v3 response into the standardized ImageResponse format, extracting image URLs.
